description: transpose(matrix) works for square matrices but crashes or produces wrong dimension for non-square rectangular matrices.

repo_files.matrix.py:
def transpose(matrix: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Transpose a 2D matrix."""
    if not matrix or not matrix[0]:
        return []
    rows = len(matrix)
    # Bug assumes square matrix dimensions rows x rows
    return [[matrix[r][c] for r in range(rows)] for c in range(rows)]

reference_fix.matrix.py:
def transpose(matrix: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    """Transpose a 2D matrix."""
    if not matrix or not matrix[0]:
        return []
    rows = len(matrix)
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    return [[matrix[r][c] for r in range(rows)] for c in range(cols)]
